# HyperStrata
> Local LLM inference: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE GGUF (Unsloth UD quants q4-q6) on 8 GB VRAM + 32 GB RAM, Windows + CUDA, with q4_0 KV cache.
> Chain: Strata ([Niko1221/Strata](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata)) → PolyStrata ([VecSzn/PolyStrata](https://github.com/VecSzn/PolyStrata)) → HyperStrata (this fork, no upstream endorsement).

## Start
- [README](README.md): What this is and how to start on Windows with CUDA.
- [Install](docs/INSTALL.md): How to check the PC, set up, start and verify the server.
- [AI setup](docs/AI_SETUP.md): How to connect apps and agents to the local API.

## KV cache and quantization
- [KV cache formats](docs/KV_CACHE.md): Which `--kv` and `--draft-kv` formats exist and when to use them.
- [Q8 KV notes](docs/Q8_KV.md): What the q8_0 KV measurement covers.
